description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Nimmi was Selected as the member of the Bandarawela Municipal Council - P. Jeyarani was Selected as the member of the Point Pedro urban Council - C. M. P. K. Ekanayaka was Selected as the member of the Nikaweratiya P/S
